name: Farmland, hydration and trampling
note: Farmland turns to dirt a tick after a solid block is set on it; entities count their falls and every landing on farmland draws its trampling check from the level random; in its random ticks it dries, is wetted by water and turns to dirt unless a crop or stem keeps it, as both official servers do
deviations: nothing tramples it (there are no living entities yet), and entities are not pushed up when it turns
